scientific_scope: Mouse-only classification is assessed within individual studies; separate GEO studies are not pooled because study and disease labels would be confounded.
reason: No individual mouse cohort contains both healthy and cancer samples in sufficient numbers for patient-independent classification. Combining cancer-only and healthy-only studies would make disease status inseparable from study, producing a misleading evaluation.

cohorts.tissue: Mammary gland; multiple normal epithelial cell populations

next_step: Add a matched mouse cancer-and-healthy cohort within the same study before running mouse-only classification.
